Keep every row in order. Preserve all [[I]], [[B]], [[SC]] emphasis markers, [[Nnumber]] note markers and explicit source line counts. Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "David Copperfield", "unit": 29, "heading": "CHAPTER 27. TOMMY TRADDLES", "previous_rows": [], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 27, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u029-h", "tag": "h2", "role": "heading", "text": "CHAPTER 27. TOMMY TRADDLES", "sha256": "c502a410b286b29a4ae31814f65e3dbb9d485a95f70d61f1c3d04d0f379f59dc", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[34]/h2", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "en85-u029-b0001", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "It may have been in consequence of Mrs. Crupp’s advice, and, perhaps, for no better reason than because there was a certain similarity in the sound of the word skittles and Traddles, that it came into my head, next day, to go and look after Traddles. The time he had mentioned was more than out, and he lived in a little street near the Veterinary College at Camden Town, which was principally tenanted, as one of our clerks who lived in that direction informed me, by gentlemen students, who bought live donkeys, and made experiments on those quadrupeds in their private apartments. Having obtained from this clerk a direction to the academic grove in question, I set out, the same afternoon, to visit my old schoolfellow.", "sha256": "d48939b1e089834a8e20da70dab9c5336d2ef00c1a519db2e1aff4758b468ee5", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[34]/p[1]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u029-b0002", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I found that the street was not as desirable a one as I could have wished it to be, for the sake of Traddles. The inhabitants appeared to have a propensity to throw any little trifles they were not in want of, into the road: which not only made it rank and sloppy, but untidy too, on account of the cabbage-leaves. The refuse was not wholly vegetable either, for I myself saw a shoe, a doubled-up saucepan, a black bonnet, and an umbrella, in various stages of decomposition, as I was looking out for the number I wanted.", "sha256": "ae34c31edf087603449b467497466cc33d6e2faab5a61d783fdf3eee3c9de148", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[34]/p[2]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u029-b0003", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "The general air of the place reminded me forcibly of the days when I lived with Mr. and Mrs. Micawber. An indescribable character of faded gentility that attached to the house I sought, and made it unlike all the other houses in the street—though they were all built on one monotonous pattern, and looked like the early copies of a blundering boy who was learning to make houses, and had not yet got out of his cramped brick-and-mortar pothooks—reminded me still more of Mr. and Mrs. Micawber. Happening to arrive at the door as it was opened to the afternoon milkman, I was reminded of Mr. and Mrs. Micawber more forcibly yet.", "sha256": "6c187e495b0675624e16668ee7a1bf6878119bd253a81a2725bb21d50e112d5a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[34]/p[3]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u029-b0004", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Now,’ said the milkman to a very youthful servant girl. ‘Has that there little bill of mine been heerd on?’", "sha256": "10b3a0fdd43390c624364272e9e61429a0fb1ca7c82de966f3861a3f31bbb17a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[34]/p[4]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u029-b0005", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Oh, master says he’ll attend to it immediate,’ was the reply.", "sha256": "77d3db6a19bbd4830bd35a06838fa8012546faf882b464b7fc0b2c114fb93f3f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[34]/p[5]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u029-b0006", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Because,’ said the milkman, going on as if he had received no answer, and speaking, as I judged from his tone, rather for the edification of somebody within the house, than of the youthful servant—an impression which was strengthened by his manner of glaring down the passage—‘because that there little bill has been running so long, that I begin to believe it’s run away altogether, and never won’t be heerd of. Now, I’m not a going to stand it, you know!’ said the milkman, still throwing his voice into the house, and glaring down the passage.", "sha256": "a4801156a51b0f45dfa72430852a56d6235052b0fea8ea9ce08d3feccaa27ed3", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[34]/p[6]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u029-b0007", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "As to his dealing in the mild article of milk, by the by, there never was a greater anomaly. His deportment would have been fierce in a butcher or a brandy-merchant.", "sha256": "fe9d4b75a76ac9c18bbc5adb38c673384620a3d5deed7ddc6d5a9dd123fe643b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[34]/p[7]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u029-b0008", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "The voice of the youthful servant became faint, but she seemed to me, from the action of her lips, again to murmur that it would be attended to immediate.", "sha256": "3ac1090f63805d17ddf000ae493405cd770dafb708ce4df56d80d2d6262f1bed", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[34]/p[8]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u029-b0009", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I tell you what,’ said the milkman, looking hard at her for the first time, and taking her by the chin, ‘are you fond of milk?’", "sha256": "d9157084141415e0d1c77964e32ce7447606c792ebf3e3b9bd3700bf5dc2edcf", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[34]/p[9]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u029-b0010", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Yes, I likes it,’ she replied. ‘Good,’ said the milkman. ‘Then you won’t have none tomorrow. D’ye hear? Not a fragment of milk you won’t have tomorrow.’", "sha256": "8fe1bc41181ba2cddd29b30801b51a3d49e72034d389d1c6877ab6446b3cea79", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[34]/p[10]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u029-b0011", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I thought she seemed, upon the whole, relieved by the prospect of having any today. The milkman, after shaking his head at her darkly, released her chin, and with anything rather than good-will opened his can, and deposited the usual quantity in the family jug. This done, he went away, muttering, and uttered the cry of his trade next door, in a vindictive shriek.", "sha256": "9d689ffb2e5811ebdc79ffe7d76f29591ac4e42a46450798b038fea54f6bc81e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[34]/p[11]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u029-b0012", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Does Mr. Traddles live here?’ I then inquired.", "sha256": "662a179053c7962390070d7e383910fadecd436df66fb9db346dd2a9f8a84ecd", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[34]/p[12]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u029-b0013", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "A mysterious voice from the end of the passage replied ‘Yes.’ Upon which the youthful servant replied ‘Yes.’", "sha256": "4b0c60364e93f2abe8377e76440213a069360dcfe14e8b95809695456c860dea", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[34]/p[13]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u029-b0014", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Is he at home?’ said I.", "sha256": "1ba1d3c29f1700e6e62a96d1da3dcc898482781245e016e32711a7e93826fac3", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[34]/p[14]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u029-b0015", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Again the mysterious voice replied in the affirmative, and again the servant echoed it. Upon this, I walked in, and in pursuance of the servant’s directions walked upstairs; conscious, as I passed the back parlour-door, that I was surveyed by a mysterious eye, probably belonging to the mysterious voice.", "sha256": "4870dbe7ad7c3ff7f80bd0dcdd0aa118decc12500b0722cdc2d33a9d12eb615b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[34]/p[15]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u029-b0016", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "When I got to the top of the stairs—the house was only a story high above the ground floor—Traddles was on the landing to meet me. He was delighted to see me, and gave me welcome, with great heartiness, to his little room. It was in the front of the house, and extremely neat, though sparely furnished. It was his only room, I saw; for there was a sofa-bedstead in it, and his blacking-brushes and blacking were among his books—on the top shelf, behind a dictionary. His table was covered with papers, and he was hard at work in an old coat. I looked at nothing, that I know of, but I saw everything, even to the prospect of a church upon his china inkstand, as I sat down—and this, too, was a faculty confirmed in me in the old Micawber times. Various ingenious arrangements he had made, for the disguise of his chest of drawers, and the accommodation of his boots, his shaving-glass, and so forth, particularly impressed themselves upon me, as evidences of the same Traddles who used to make models of elephants’ dens in writing-paper to put flies in; and to comfort himself under ill usage, with the memorable works of art I have so often mentioned.", "sha256": "2f2ba024551a8193c948077d5bed3b8e0c70fd36820ae198360f78932fb8dd5b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[34]/p[16]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u029-b0017", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "In a corner of the room was something neatly covered up with a large white cloth. I could not make out what that was.", "sha256": "404d5c2cc15aa70bcf856115a96b3f8f28f8994ac8011b7fc3eae642fc68422a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[34]/p[17]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u029-b0018", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Traddles,’ said I, shaking hands with him again, after I had sat down, ‘I am delighted to see you.’", "sha256": "d82935a06b50cc98328d943dc6c675eafd616261b64866a46ac554f41875e606", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[34]/p[18]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u029-b0019", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I am delighted to see YOU, Copperfield,’ he returned. ‘I am very glad indeed to see you. It was because I was thoroughly glad to see you when we met in Ely Place, and was sure you were thoroughly glad to see me, that I gave you this address instead of my address at chambers.’ ‘Oh! You have chambers?’ said I.", "sha256": "b7f102ce0cf64b00f706bb9789785da166a615bab9fd170b71373a709251c02d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[34]/p[19]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u029-b0020", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Why, I have the fourth of a room and a passage, and the fourth of a clerk,’ returned Traddles. ‘Three others and myself unite to have a set of chambers—to look business-like—and we quarter the clerk too. Half-a-crown a week he costs me.’", "sha256": "6a98ee08bc1357510c74548dd39339e219e6d6a6c01577aea5b17965c896903b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[34]/p[20]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u029-b0021", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "His old simple character and good temper, and something of his old unlucky fortune also, I thought, smiled at me in the smile with which he made this explanation.", "sha256": "1fcc623a7b23e93ca42d8894bdb7a206bcfeec92fda5fc3ed728a9145d413669", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[34]/p[21]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u029-b0022", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘It’s not because I have the least pride, Copperfield, you understand,’ said Traddles, ‘that I don’t usually give my address here. It’s only on account of those who come to me, who might not like to come here. For myself, I am fighting my way on in the world against difficulties, and it would be ridiculous if I made a pretence of doing anything else.’", "sha256": "66cedd3fefffd9be4f40bf5f314f15081ed0a2db1c39e310b022508c97f5fa85", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[34]/p[22]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u029-b0023", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘You are reading for the bar, Mr. Waterbrook informed me?’ said I.", "sha256": "3682803e3f476f1c9408c114f9997b00dd795168f1edf341d4fc5b188fcba859", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[34]/p[23]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u029-b0024", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Why, yes,’ said Traddles, rubbing his hands slowly over one another. ‘I am reading for the bar. The fact is, I have just begun to keep my terms, after rather a long delay. It’s some time since I was articled, but the payment of that hundred pounds was a great pull. A great pull!’ said Traddles, with a wince, as if he had had a tooth out.", "sha256": "2ae84b870c6e6ca9230dfa0816723b82366a659834be6031b9ebeb50726ec17d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[34]/p[24]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u029-b0025", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Do you know what I can’t help thinking of, Traddles, as I sit here looking at you?’ I asked him.", "sha256": "470d4a4085e4feaa27e8e498ed7c25221bcda6320e32bb70ff1effe76fce2c0c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[34]/p[25]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u029-b0026", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘No,’ said he.", "sha256": "9f1e904b870813daa98fbdd044547b193e840b65798d24c0c1ba78a1aba8b077", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[34]/p[26]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u029-b0027", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘That sky-blue suit you used to wear.’", "sha256": "a85b8ac18445b8a66fd40b306b179888c7c674c43ea56f6c2cfa065bac31f109", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[34]/p[27]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u029-b0028", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Lord, to be sure!’ cried Traddles, laughing. ‘Tight in the arms and legs, you know? Dear me! Well! Those were happy times, weren’t they?’", "sha256": "ce441e3162f04d7f96198f69c565827101dde1c12933c6b564efc72829c29000", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[34]/p[28]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u029-b0029", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I think our schoolmaster might have made them happier, without doing any harm to any of us, I acknowledge,’ I returned.", "sha256": "d8b31bd45ca7faa7d3548bb125dce08a09aaf0922030efc164ab0381cc09c614", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[34]/p[29]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u029-b0030", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Perhaps he might,’ said Traddles. ‘But dear me, there was a good deal of fun going on. Do you remember the nights in the bedroom? When we used to have the suppers? And when you used to tell the stories? Ha, ha, ha! And do you remember when I got caned for crying about Mr. Mell? Old Creakle! I should like to see him again, too!’", "sha256": "b9ec67104680b7c909e7396778c43f35549d2f8158c8bb13f5e6e99b19009585", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[34]/p[30]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u029-b0031", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘He was a brute to you, Traddles,’ said I, indignantly; for his good humour made me feel as if I had seen him beaten but yesterday.", "sha256": "80784a57486748721a46319fcc0c9f92c3cf3d618ac7fd780408e2813500a6dd", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[34]/p[31]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}]}
